verdict.rationale: Adyen Uplift gives merchants recommendations tailored to their business and uses AI to optimize conversion, risk and cost, with experiments they can start, evaluate and stop. ML fraud detection trained on global transaction data also feeds automated block, allow or review decisions. However, the evidence frames this as payment-funnel optimization rather than general AI insights over the merchant's own data, and reporting is described only as visual dashboards. Missing for 10: general AI-generated insights or summaries over reporting data in the Customer Area, any natural-language or conversational in-product analytics, detail on how recommendations are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
